messages:
Dana (Auditor): Hi team — prepping evidence for an upcoming SOC2/ISO spot review. Need clarity on: RBAC pre/post snapshots for sampled high-priv changes, KMS rotation proofs (including HSM-stamped rotations + policy hash), ephemeral key usage logs, vuln triage -> incident mapping, and signed export bundle with verification steps. Also need a control crosswalk file mapping artifacts to control IDs. Req: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/spotcheck-2026-07

Priya (sec-eng): Hi Dana — we can deliver that. Quick Q: sampling strategy 1) focus on high-privilege roles & any service-account changes? 2) retention: 1 year preferred?

Dana (Auditor): Focused sample is fine. 1 year minimum, 3 years if feasible. For KMS: please include both long-term CMKs and ephemeral data keys used by services (with CloudTrail event IDs). We need the key policy canonical hash and the HSM stamp/attestation for any HSM-backed rotations. Timestamps must be RFC3339 UTC.

Sanjay (eng-security): Plan:
- rbac/samples/<id>-pre.csv and <id>-post.csv (role,principal,type,k8s_audit_event_id)
- iam/history/<role>-versions.csv (version,author,ts,commit_sha)
- kms/rotations.csv (alias,key_id,rotation_ts,rotation_version,policy_sha256,hsm_attestation_id,cloudtrail_event_id)
- kms/ephemeral_keys.csv (service,ephemeral_key_id,generate_ts,expiry_ts,cloudtrail_event_id)
- vuln/triage_map.csv (vuln_id,cvss,discover_ts,owner,fix_pr,deploy_ts,incident_id)
- sa/deprov.csv (sa_email,actor,ts,pr_link,pipeline_run_url)
- control_crosswalk.csv (file_name,control_id)
We sign the bundle with our audit GPG key and include manifest.sha256. We'll also include a small verification README with exact commands.

Priya (sec-eng): Implementation notes: for KMS policy hashing we use jq -S . to canonicalize and then sha256sum; we'll include both policy.json and policy_canonical.json for each key so you can reproduce. For HSM rotations we include the attestation artifact id (hsm_attestation_id) and a short human-readable attestation excerpt.

Liam (infra): I'll schedule an export and attach an oncall trace. @oncall-bot start audit-export --bundle=spot-2026-07-ephemeral --include=rbac,iam,kms,ephemeral,vuln,sa

oncall-bot: Export queued: job_id=job-3007654321-9, started_at=2026-09-01T09:20:05Z, target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/spot-2026/job-9. Progress updates will be posted to this thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Dana (Auditor): Two clarifications before you run: 1) for ephemeral keys include the generate_ts and expiry_ts plus the principal that requested it; 2) in the manifest please include a short per-file envelope line that contains file path, sha256, control_id(s), and for kms rows also alias+policy_sha256. Example manifest line format: file_path | sha256 | control_ids | meta(key_alias=...,policy_sha256=...)

Sanjay (eng-security): Good ask. We'll adopt that manifest-line format and include an accompanying manifest.json that mirrors the lines (for programmatic parsing). All timestamps UTC.

Priya (sec-eng): We'll include pre/post snapshots captured within 3 minutes of the audited change event (per k8s audit event timestamp) and attach the audit event id so you can cross-reference. For SA deprovs we'll include the PR link and the CI pipeline log snippet showing the revoke succeeded (redacted). If you need full logs, we can provide access via a limited viewer session.

oncall-bot: job_id=job-3007654321-9 update: gather phase complete. Bundling artifacts into spot-2026-07-ephemeral-job-9.tar.gz. Signing manifest and generating sha256 sums.

Liam (infra): Upload complete. s3://redwood-audit-exports/spot-2026/job-9/spot-2026-07-ephemeral-job-9.tar.gz. Generating presigned URL (7d).

oncall-bot: job_id=job-3007654321-9 complete: presigned URL: https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/spot-2026/job-9/spot-2026-07-ephemeral-job-9.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800. Manifest file name: spot-2026-07-ephemeral.manifest.txt; signed manifest: spot-2026-07-ephemeral.manifest.sig

Dana (Auditor): Downloaded and started verification. A couple micro-asks after quick scan: 1) can you include the exact jq+sha256 command used for policy canonicalization in the README? 2) for HSM attestation excerpts, include the fingerprint of the signing HSM cert. Otherwise initial pass looks complete. I'll send follow-ups within 48h after deep review.

Priya (sec-eng): Will add the exact command and include HSM cert fingerprint in the attestation excerpt. Example command we will document: `jq -S . key-policy.json | tr -d '\n' | sha256sum` and we will create policy_canonical.json alongside the raw policy.

Sanjay (eng-security): Adding control IDs to manifest lines as requested. We'll also include a small script `verify_manifest.sh` in the bundle that runs `gpg --verify` and `sha256sum -c` and parses the manifest-lines for quick checks.

Liam (infra): Noted. If you request extended retention (3y) we can re-run and store an extended export. For now the sample bundle uses default 1y retention metadata.

Dana (Auditor): Thanks all 1) please post the updated presigned link after README/attestation fingerprint added; 2) I'll confirm within 48h after deep review. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
